Message:
The drowning that happened
long ago in this lake...
I heard it happened after
a boat crashed into the reef,
submerging many of its
passengers in the lake depths...

Since then,
no one dares draw near...
In truth, this is my first time
coming here as well...

But, it does feel
quite sad here, somehow...

It was then that it happened...
Following a loud crash of water,
I could hear something
scramble up from
out of the lake...

This ominous aura can only
belong to a cursed creature...!
And it is not just one or two...

A whole horde of cursed
creatures is heading
towards the lakeshore...!

Over there is the estate
everyone is staying at...!
I must stop them at once...!

But, just then...
I heard the sound of
even louder footsteps
stop right in front of me...

What a terrifying presence
this creature has...
As if it is a gathering
of only the darkest of emotions...!

As the cursed creature before me
howled into the air,
I became enshrouded
by a cold, clammy wind...

This wind feels like fog
against my skin...
but for some reason...
its presence fills me with dread...!
